# ExPhoneNumber v0.4.11 - Table of Contents

A library for parsing, formatting, and validating international phone numbers. Based on Google's libphonenumber.

## Pages

- [ExPhoneNumber](https://ex-phone-number.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ex-phone-number.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Changelog](https://ex-phone-number.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [ExPhoneNumber](https://ex-phone-number.hexdocs.pm/ExPhoneNumber.md): Parsing, formatting, and validating international phone numbers.
- [ExPhoneNumber.Constants.PhoneNumberTypes](https://ex-phone-number.hexdocs.pm/ExPhoneNumber.Constants.PhoneNumberTypes.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix update_metadata](https://ex-phone-number.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.UpdateMetadata.md): Downloads the latest libphonenumber metadata from GitHub
